title: A flow a composed stack declares only on its top level, beside package bodies, is never registered with the automation engine at boot — the manifest service registers the residual's objects and connectors only
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dhraZ7BwSanQPGEAb
Filing gate: ③ out-of-scope finding of os-dev-report 6520658127 (#28032, PR #28046), measured here before filing.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "residual top-level flow not registered manifest service unclaimedTopLevel package bodies" → 0 hits; "top-level items no package body declares registered only into metadata service engine registry" → none this work (#22521 closed: the config-boot half of the residual rule for the metadata door; #14599 closed).
Reader: the epic PM (#27261), the lane that owns the engine `manifest` service (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`).
type: Bug

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 合成栈（`composeStacks`，`manifest: 'preserve'`）里，如果某个输入带 `packages[]` 包体，又只在顶层声明了一个 flow（没有包体声明同名），开机后这个 flow 进了元数据服务，但没有进 ObjectQL 注册表，自动化引擎在开机时也没有注册它：`getFlow` 返回空，它的触发器不会挂上。包体里声明的 flow 正常。
- **原因：** ObjectQL 的 `manifest` 服务对这类"残留"顶层项只注册对象（ADR-0130 D4）和连接器（#28046）。其余从注册表读取的集合（flows、permissions 等 `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`）只进元数据服务。
- **影响：** 只有手工构造的嵌套或混合输入会遇到，常规单栈和 `last` 合成不受影响。边缘形状。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Measured (at PR #28046 head a5d4ed3f, whose objectql registers residual objects and connectors)

A real kernel (ObjectKernel, ObjectQLPlugin over SQLite, AutomationServicePlugin) boots `composeStacks([mixed, other], { manifest: 'preserve' })` through the `manifest` service, the way `AppPlugin` hands a config boot's stack to it. `mixed` carries `packages: [{ manifest: { id: 'com.acme.orders', flows: [acme_body_flow] } }]` and, on its top level only, `flows: [acme_residual_flow]`.

- The composed stack's top level carries `acme_residual_flow`; no body declares it, so it is residual (`unclaimedTopLevel`).
- `ql.registry.listItems('flow')` after boot: `[["acme_body_flow","com.acme.orders"]]`. The residual flow is absent.
- `automation.listFlows()`: `["acme_body_flow"]`. `automation.getFlow('acme_residual_flow')` is `null`; `getFlow('acme_body_flow')` answers.

The automation plugin's boot pull reads `ql.registry.listItems('flow')` (`service-automation/src/plugin.ts`, the boot pull around :1536), so a residual flow never reaches it. The metadata door registers it under the stack's `manifest.id` (`MetadataPlugin.registerUnclaimedTopLevel`), so `/meta` lists a flow that never runs.

## By reading (not measured)

The same holds for every collection in `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` (`objectql/src/engine.ts`) other than objects and connectors: the `manifest` service registers bodies through `registerApp` and, of the residual, only `unclaimedTopLevelObjects` and (with #28046) `unclaimedTopLevelConnectors`. Readers that take permissions from the registry (for example `plugin-security`'s `packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`, `ql.registry.listItems('permission')`) would miss a residual permission set the same way.

## Task

- [ ] Decide the shape of the fix: register the whole residual through the registration body a package's collections take (`registerMetadataCollections`), under the residual rule's id, or extend the per-type registration (objects, connectors) type by type. The first is one path for every type; it also makes a residual flow, permission set or job live at boot, which is what the metadata door already reports.
- [ ] A test pins the boot-time reading for a residual flow, and for one security-domain type, both directions (residual registered; a body's own unchanged).

`Clause-②:` decided from the diff · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
